verdict.rationale: Brave publishes an official MCP server (brave/brave-search-mcp-server) exposing web/local/image/video/news search, LLM context, and summarization tools, with first-party guides for connecting it to Claude desktop, OpenClaw, and Dify agents. However, community evidence shows a real caveat: the standard free-tier ToS reportedly prohibits using API responses for AI inference, requiring users to switch to a separate AI Inference plan to legitimately use the MCP server with agents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation the MCP server works reliably in production, and clearer first-party guidance reconciling ToS terms with the MCP/agent use case.
